title: Retry backoff ignores the cap
prompt: Retry delays are wrong. With `{ baseMs: 200, maxMs: 1000 }` we see waits of 400, 800, 1200, 1600 ms. They should start at baseMs, grow by `factor` (default 2) each retry, and never go above maxMs. The code is in src/retry.ts.
failToPass: waits the backoff delays between tries
